source_metadata.title: Comparative Effectiveness of Empagliflozin vs Liraglutide or Sitagliptin in Older Adults With Diverse Patient Characteristics
source_metadata.citation: Htoo PT, Tesfaye H, Schneeweiss S, et al. JAMA Network Open. 2022;5(10):e2237606.
source_metadata.source_type: retrospective new-user active-comparator comparative-effectiveness cohort study

consistency_findings.detail: Main article states the study period ended September 30, 2018, while supplement eTable 2 labels censoring as “End of study - 12/31/2018.” This was not reconciled or normalized.

Supplement flow diagrams show 61 and 91 otherwise-eligible patients who did not begin follow-up because they were not alive one day after cohort entry; subtracting these explains the slightly lower pre-match cohort counts in the main text.

schema_gaps: The schema has one quantitative_result object per atom, so hazard ratios and rate differences are represented as separate atoms even when reported in the same table row.
No dedicated field exists for interaction/homogeneity p-values; these are preserved in canonical/source context when central but not normalized into quantitative_result.
extraction_limitations: Supplement eFigures 3 and 4 were reconciled in the SEA artifact but not exhaustively atomized cell-by-cell; the source’s class-comparator overall estimates and main subgroup claims were extracted.
Baseline tables were represented through population/balance atoms rather than one atom per descriptive cell.
No missing clinical details were imputed; dosing and laboratory values were left unspecified when not reported in claims data.
